methods.name: estimate_initial_fsrs_state
methods.purpose: Pure function. Synthesizes {stability, difficulty, fsrs_state, step, last_review_at, raw_state} for a card with real review history but no native FSRS state, per 10_architecture.json §contracts.invariants' legacy-migration-approximation entry. Stability via the FSRS-6 interval<->stability inversion (constants confirmed against the installed fsrs==6.3.2 source); difficulty via one review_card() call on a fresh Card() with Rating.Good; raw_state via Card(...).to_dict(), never a hand-assembled dict.

private_objects.name: _FSRS_SCHEDULER
private_objects.purpose: Module-level fsrs.Scheduler(desired_retention=DESIRED_RETENTION). Unchanged singleton-safety rationale from Sprint10.

private_objects.name: _GRADE_TO_FSRS_RATING
private_objects.purpose: Unchanged — grade name -> fsrs.Rating by name.

private_objects.name: _FSRS6_FACTOR
private_objects.purpose: 19/81 — FSRS-6's fixed forgetting-curve constant, confirmed against the installed library source before use in estimate_initial_fsrs_state.

private_objects.name: _FSRS6_DECAY
private_objects.purpose: -0.5 — FSRS-6's fixed forgetting-curve constant, confirmed against the installed library source before use in estimate_initial_fsrs_state.

private_objects.name: _MIN_STABILITY_DAYS
private_objects.purpose: Floor applied to the inverted stability so a very short review_interval never produces a non-positive stability — confirm against the installed library's own minimum if one is exposed, else use a small fixed floor (e.g. 0.01).

files.role: [NEW] One-time, idempotent startup migration: backfills fsrs_card_state for every flashcard_review_state row with real review history and no native FSRS state yet, using backend.scheduling.estimate_initial_fsrs_state. Invoked once from backend/main.py's startup sequence, after init_schema() succeeds.

methods.name: migrate_legacy_fsrs_state
methods.purpose: Selects every flashcard_review_state row with last_reviewed_at IS NOT NULL and no fsrs_card_state row; for each, computes and INSERTs the synthesized state in its own small transaction so one bad row is logged and skipped, not startup-blocking. Returns a summary dict ({attempted, succeeded, skipped}) for startup logging.
